title: Cold War English-Russian playing cards for communicating with hostages

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. But um the purpose was that uh we had English and Russian. So if if we wanted to show what a word is in English, they would read it in Russian and it was a means for us to communicate.

plain: Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, says that during the Cold War there were playing cards printed in both English and Russian. He says the purpose was communication: you could show a word in English and the other person could read it in Russian, a way to talk with hostages or captives. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast as a detail from his own experience.
